args.query: order-service NullPointerException margin validator FNO orders 500

events.statement: order-service error rate jumped from ~0.2% baseline to ~18-20% starting in the 12:12 bucket and remained elevated (~18.7%) through 13:48.

A single order-service deployment dep-5101 (v2.14.0) went live at 2026-03-03T12:10:00Z, summarized 'Refactor order validation; add margin check for F&O orders' with changes 'new MarginCheckValidator in validation chain' and 'remove legacy OrderRules.validateMargin()'.
First order-service error appears at 12:12:31Z, ~2 minutes after the 12:10 deploy: 'NullPointerException at MarginCheckValidator.validate(MarginCheckValidator.java:88) orderType=FNO'.
There were zero ERROR-level order-service log entries in the 11:30-12:12 window before/at the deploy, i.e. errors began only after dep-5101.

All 426 order-service ERROR entries in the window are one of two patterns tied to the new validator: 224x 'NullPointerException at MarginCheckValidator.validate(...) orderType=FNO' and 202x 'order rejected with 500: java.lang.NullPointerException: marginProfile is null for account ...'.
Every NPE log line references orderType=FNO; no other order type appears in the error patterns.
order-service resource metrics are flat across the incident: latency_p99_ms ~150ms unchanged, cpu_pct ~40%, memory_pct ~60%, db_pool_in_use ~14, request_rate ~232 req/s.
Downstream exchange-gateway shows no degradation: error_rate stayed ~0.2% and there were zero ERROR logs in the window; pricing-engine also had zero ERROR logs.
The only config/flag change in the window is unrelated: notification-service email.batch_size 200->250 at 11:21 (cfg-2101); no order-service config change exists.
dep-5101 is still 'live' with rolled_back_at null; no rollback was performed.
Historical incident HIST-115 (order-service config misconfiguration) and HIST-110/103 differ in symptom (pool exhaustion, external outage); no past incident matches a validator NPE on FNO orders.
